## Corrections Applied From 2026-06-02 Visual Capture (override BRD inferences)

1. **Click target** — React onClick handler is on `.unit-size-item` wrapper, NOT `.unit-number`. All click steps use `.unit-size-item`.
2. **No per-unit status toggle** in UAT. The "unit status toggle" referenced in earlier draft was actually the **tower-level** Active/Inactive switch on `/admin/cms` (Config). Re-scoped accordingly.
3. **Deep-link direction reversed** — "View Tower >" link lives on the Config page (`/admin/cms`) and navigates TO `/admin/towers`. There is NO "View Tower" link on the Towers page itself.
4. **No hover tooltip** — hovering a unit produces no `.ant-tooltip` or `.ant-popover`. The unit-detail panel is the only surfacing mechanism.
5. **Toggle is immediate** — flipping the Active/Inactive switch on Config triggers NO confirmation dialog. State change is instant and server-persisted.
6. **Unit detail container** — `div.more-details-allocation` (an inline custom panel, NOT `.ant-drawer`, NOT `.ant-modal`).
7. **Cell status classes** — wrapper carries `.unit-size-item.<status>`: `booked` (red), `hold` (orange / paying-now), `available` (white + green border), `reserved` (grey/disabled), `not_available` (plain white), `refuge` (grey w/ literal "REFUGE" text).

### BRD/FRD gaps for BA Agent to file (post-approval)

- **BRD-TWR-GAP-001:** BRD §5.5 says "clicking a red (sold) unit does not open any panel" and §6 Rule 5 extends this to orange/grey. Visual capture proves this is FALSE for `.unit-size-item.booked` and `.unit-size-item.hold` — both open `div.more-details-allocation` with a customer block. Only `.unit-size-item.reserved` and `.unit-size-item.refuge` truly do not open a panel. BRD §5.5 + §6 Rule 5 need correction. TCs 011, 012 already test the correct behaviour.
- **BRD-TWR-GAP-002:** BRD §5 silent on toolbar button behaviour (Download unit registrations, Pre-Booked Payments, Refresh). Behaviour, file format, and PBT destination undocumented. TCs 020, 021 cover.
- **BRD-TWR-GAP-003:** BRD §4 Zone 4 lists drawer fields as Unit Number / BHK Type / Size / Agreement Value / Early Bird Discount / All Inclusive Price. INDEX.md (and §11.7 reconciliation) shows actual fields are Unit No. / BHK / Size / Agreement Value / Final AV / Stamp Duty / GST / Registration Charges / *All inclusive (total) — plus customer block for booked/hold units. BRD §4 Zone 4 needs to be brought in line with INDEX.md observed UI.
- **BRD-TWR-GAP-004:** BRD §5 silent on "Pre-Booked Payments" button. Toolbar button exists; no walkthrough or destination documented. (Captured in INDEX.md; behaviour TC not generated since destination unknown — file as gap.)
